headline: Sensex rises over 500 points, Nifty ends near 25,300 led by FMCG and foreign inflows

marketStatus.message: Market is open for trading today.

why: Foreign equity inflows continue to drive early trade rallies and blunt global headwinds.
FMCG and banking shares outshine, leading gains across benchmark indices.
Lower crude oil prices provided additional support to investor sentiment.
SEBI's plan to propose raising the FPI beneficial ownership threshold to 25% bolstered market confidence.
whatHappening: Sensex settled over 500 points higher while Nifty finished near 25,291.
Max Healthcare emerged as the top gaining stock during market hours.
Rupee gained strength as market volatility ebbed due to steady inflows.
Swiggy highlighted among midcap stocks experiencing corrections up to 50% in CY26.
summary: Indian equities posted strong gains as Sensex surged over 500 points and Nifty closed near 25,300. The rally was boosted by persistent foreign fund inflows, lower crude oil prices, and buying in FMCG and banking stocks. Max Healthcare, Asian Paints, and Bharti Airtel were among the major stock gainers.
